judgments.fix: §9.3: 'Probe values are strictly probe-scoped (D-051). No published cell and no service evaluation holds one. A fresh table holds the probe's values until a sweep first writes a cell, so a read before `init!` returns them. They never serve as initial root-input values, since every complete-world application refuses unwritten root inputs as `UninitializedInputs`.' Also change the §6.3 citation at src/build.jl:563 and :1503 to §9.3.
